_about: Every public-domain Thomas Watson (c.1620-1686, St Stephen's Walbrook) text the Word Hoard holds. Watson has no collected Works. CCEL ThML is clean and is fetched for every CCEL Watson title (Body of Divinity, Ten Commandments, Lord's Prayer, Beatitudes, Divine Contentment, Divine Cordial). Internet Archive OCR adds the Select Works (New York: Robert Carter, 1855), which carries further sermons and treatises, and The Saints' Spiritual Delight (1830), raw and unconverted. No Gutenberg Watson exists (searched 2026-10-02). Not to be confused with Thomas Watson, Bishop of Lincoln (1513-1584), Richard Watson (1781-1833) or Thomas E. Watson (1856-1922).

watson-beatitudes: The Beatitudes: An Exposition of Matthew 5:1-12

watson-select-works-1855: The Select Works of the Rev. Thomas Watson (New York: Robert Carter, 1855)
